mandatory_gates.name: Vision, ownership & target architecture
acceptance: Target engine capability inventory and in-salon user journey signed off
Canonical responsibility and ENG-ID mapping aligned with ADR and frozen versioned contracts
No unresolved critical architectural drift or dual ownership

mandatory_gates.name: Functional completeness and professional fidelity
acceptance: Every required MVP/V2/V3 in-scope behavior implemented with pass/fail scenarios
Real service-specific edge cases, failure modes and uncertainty handled
No hidden synthetic fixtures or invented expertise represented as real execution

mandatory_gates.name: Typed versioned interfaces and traceability
acceptance: Published schema validation and backward compatibility matrix
Idempotency, causality, input provenance and error taxonomy enforced
All required input/output handoffs and integration tests passing

mandatory_gates.name: Independent execution and deployment
acceptance: Own independently deployable process/image, config and lifecycle
Identity, secret, health and resource isolation under managed private networking
Independent kill/restart/upgrade and no hidden in-process/mock fallback
evidence: separate process and failure isolation test

mandatory_gates.name: Zero trust / tenant / consent
acceptance: Managed service identity mTLS with issuer, cert revocation and JWT audience/nonce replay protections
Tenant+branch+session RLS, deny-by-default data handling and least privileges verified
Consent purpose, erasure/retention, logs redaction and independent security review complete
evidence: live cert and PKI verification record

mandatory_gates.name: Durability and resilience
acceptance: Claim/Lease/ACK or equivalent exact event contract, idempotency and reprocessing
DLQ, backpressure, timeout, retry and compensation under faults
Backup/restore, outage recovery and no duplicated durable effects

mandatory_gates.name: Measured system performance and capacity
acceptance: Business SLOs, load model and hardware class approved before benchmark
p50/p95/p99 latency, errors and saturation measured with reproducible fixtures
Sustained concurrency, cold start, memory/CPU and rollback under load pass SLO
evidence: reproducible benchmark with load and environment

mandatory_gates.name: Real-world service and specialist quality
acceptance: Service expert verifies correctness against approved SOP and safety bounds
Uncertainty and unknown evidence block unsafe recommendations or technical plans
Identity preservation, visual fidelity and real-world feasibility independently evaluated where applicable

mandatory_gates.name: Operability and lifecycle
acceptance: End-to-end trace correlation, metrics, alerts and audit with retention controls
Versioned deploy/rollback, on-call owner, incident escalation and runbooks
No secrets or PII leak in logs, metrics or error messages

mandatory_gates.name: Separate accountable acceptance
acceptance: External professional and independent security reviewers both verified by distinct trust issuers
Attestations bind exact engine ID, commit SHA, evidence manifest digest and approved product scope
Owner reviews real deployment/cost/rollback evidence separately from design approval

completion_prohibited_if: missing real-provider deployment and operational data
synthetic-only capabilities presented as real AI
